transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... hi. I guess I'm here because... well, I've been having some trouble with eating lately. It's just that once I start, sometimes it feels like I hit some kind of switch. I just keep going, even when a part of me is thinking... you know, 'Dennis, just stop already.' But I don't. So... yeah. That's why I came in.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating?
No. Um... I don't do that.
Do you feel guilty after these eating episodes?

Yeah... I guess so. Mostly I just feel... embarrassed. And kind of grossed out with myself. It's just... I'm usually pretty disciplined, you know? Like with my classes and robotics and stuff. So... doing that just makes me feel like I'm not in control.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Um... I mean, I guess nobody really wants to gain weight, right? But... it's not like I'm constantly stressing over the scale or anything. I just... I don't know. It's more about the eating itself, I think.
How often do these episodes of eating until you feel out of control happen?

Um... I guess it's been happening most weeks. Usually just like... one night a week. Sometimes two, if things are really stressful with deadlines or if there's just a lot of food around the apartment. It's been like that since early in the semester... so maybe three or four months now.
Do you ever exercise excessively to make up for the amount you eat during these episodes?
Um... no. Not really. I don't really work out much anyway. Just... walking to my classes and stuff. So... no.
Do you typically eat a large amount of food in a short period of time during these episodes?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Like... if I just had a big project deadline, or if there's leftover pizza sitting around the apartment... I'll take it to my room and just... eat the whole thing. And then maybe grab some chips or cereal, too. I don't know. It's... it's a lot more than I plan to eat. Definitely way more than my roommates would eat for a normal dinner.
Do you typically try to follow a very strict diet or restrict certain types of food when you're not having one of these eating episodes?
Um... no. Not really. I don't really diet or... cut things out. I just eat whatever, mostly.
Do you usually eat these large amounts of food alone?

Um... yeah. Mostly. Like... if my roommates are hanging out in the kitchen, I'll just eat a normal-ish amount. But then... I'll usually just grab extra stuff and take it back to my room later. I just... I don't really want them seeing how much I'm actually eating. So... yeah. Alone.
Do you ever fast or skip meals to make up for the amount you eat during these episodes?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I don't really skip meals. I just eat normal, I guess.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past few months?
Um... not really, no. I don't... I don't weigh myself that much, but my clothes still fit the same, so... probably not.
Do you ever use laxatives or diuretics after one of these eating episodes?
Um... no. I don't... I've never used anything like that.
Do you usually have these eating episodes when you're feeling stressed or emotional?
Um... I don't know. I guess I haven't really thought about it. I don't think I'm, like, super emotional or anything when it happens. It just... kind of happens sometimes.
Do you think you usually eat this way when you're feeling stressed, anxious, or upset?
Um... like I said, I don't really think so. I'm not really paying attention to that kind of stuff when it happens. I don't think I'm anxious or anything, I just... I just eat.
Do you worry about your body shape or weight?
Um... not really, no. I mean, I guess everyone thinks about it a little, but... it's not something I really worry about.
Are you afraid that if you don't control your eating, you will gain weight?
Um... no, not really. I don't really think about it like that. I'm not... afraid of it or anything.
Do you ever try to compensate for what you eat during these episodes in any way?
Um... no. Like... I don't throw up or anything, if that's what you mean. I just... I don't do anything after. I just kind of go back to whatever I was doing.
Do you usually feel self-critical after these episodes of eating?

Um... yeah, I guess. I just... feel kind of embarrassed afterward. Like, a bit grossed out with myself. I'm usually pretty disciplined with things... you know, with school, and my robotics stuff. So... I don't know. It just makes me feel like I'm not in control, I guess.
Do you ever try to eat less or follow a stricter diet after one of these episodes?
Um... no. Not really. I don't really do diets or... try to restrict things. I just kind of eat like normal the next day, I guess.
Do you ever try to make up for what you eat during these episodes by doing something to try to prevent weight gain?
Um... no. Like I said before, I don't really do anything to... make up for it. I don't work out a ton or take anything, if that's what you mean. I just kind of... leave it.
